achievement.name: Credential viewer checklist
achievement.description: Confirms the platform can present issuer profile, subject, and achievement fields from an Open Badges 3.0–aligned VC without extra local context.

criteria.narrative: In the playground, issue this credential, open it in the viewer, and confirm the achievement name, type, description, and this criteria narrative appear as human-readable text (not only raw JSON).
